subject: [PATCH 1/5] mm/gup: convert follow_page_mask() to return a long

2026-08-01.patch_summary: This patch changes the return type of the follow_page_mask() function from a struct page pointer to a long integer. The function can now return either 0, a negative error number, or 1 with the found page stored in a new pages[0] slot. This change is made to allow for future modifications that will carry a page count in the return value. The patch also updates several related functions and tests to accommodate this change without introducing any functional changes.
